protocol.supersedes: v1 computed the value gap from a 3y revenue CAGR the engine never filled (annual periods are not passed), so no value-gap position was ever taken; no value-gap outcome was seen. Surprise and revision definitions are unchanged.
protocol.base: heuristic-direction-replay.v1 sessions, window, reward, unit and interval

signals.surprise: latest known EPS surprise (strict availability), event within 92 days: LONG >= +2.0%, SHORT <= -2.0%
signals.value_gap: 3y revenue CAGR (TTM revenue vs TTM revenue 12 quarters earlier, annualized) minus reverse-DCF implied CAGR (TTM FCF, 9% discount, 2.5% terminal, 5 years); monthly terciles among names with a gap (>= 9): top LONG, bottom SHORT
signals.value_timed: value_gap direction, entered only when the technical component has the same sign

hypotheses.H8: value_timed beats value_gap (technical timing adds value)

protocol.test: mean monthly reward (or paired difference) > 0 and its lower 95% bound > 0
protocol.coverage: at least 24 months with an active position, else INSUFFICIENT_COVERAGE
protocol.not_testable: fair value delivered through options: no historical option surfaces exist (capture is forward-only)
protocol.use: baseline for the forward direction test; never changes trading, the live protocol or promotion
caveats: Universe is today's coverage list: survivorship-biased.
Fundamental scoring thresholds were hand-set in 2026 with knowledge of these histories.
No historical headlines: the news component is missing throughout.
The replay composite has no earnings-surprise (expectations) input.
Short positions carry no borrow cost; fills are at closes with fixed costs.
Surprise and consensus history exist only where this system stored them with their observation time; nothing is backfilled from current estimates.
Reverse-DCF conventions (9%, 2.5%, 5 years) are documented choices, not fitted.
